quests.title: Field Sketches
quests.description: Lumeria is full of shy, gentle creatures. Watching quietly is the best way to meet them.

steps.text: Stand or walk calmly near a creature to sketch it
Befriend a creature with treats it likes (E)

hints: Creatures come closer when you stand still. Running makes them shy. Each creature has favourite treats, shown when you greet it.

quests.title: The Dimming Pines
quests.description: Gloom has settled over parts of Misty Pinewood. It isn't dangerous, only sad and grey.

steps.text: Visit Misty Pinewood, south-west of the meadow
Make a Bright Lantern at a workbench
Clear a patch of gloom with its light

hints: A Bright Lantern needs your lantern, 3 crystal shards, 1 sea glass and 2 glowcaps. Gloomlings are only shy: light, a song or food all help.

quests.title: A Family in the Fog
quests.description: Somewhere in the pinewood, a mother fox is waiting for her kits.

steps.text: Find the fox den in the north-west of the pinewood
Lead the lost kits home from the gloom

hints: The kits hide in the pinewood's gloom patches. Clear the gloom, press E by a kit, and it will follow you to the den.

quests.title: Light on the Water
quests.description: The old lighthouse on the Sunpetal Coast has been dark for a long time.

steps.text: Find the lighthouse on the Sunpetal Coast
Mend the lighthouse door and stairs
Fit a new lens and relight the lamp

hints: Driftwood, shells and sea glass wash up all along the coast. Glowcaps grow in Firefly Grove, resin in the pinewood.

quests.title: Across the Calm Sea
quests.description: Out past the lighthouse, a little isle holds an old shipwreck.

steps.text: Read the shipwright's plans near the lighthouse
Build a Small Boat at the cottage workbench
Sail from the lighthouse dock to the Wreck Isle
Set the wreck's signal lanterns right

hints: The captain's log on the isle explains the signal. The lever always starts it over.
